name: Marc Forsmark Nielsen
title: Senior Frontend Developer
tagline: Building performant, beautiful interfaces with React & TypeScript
about: I'm a Senior Frontend Engineer based in Copenhagen, with 6+ years building performant, detail-obsessed interfaces across SaaS, medtech, and data-heavy platforms. I care deeply about the intersection of engineering rigour and great UX — the kind of work where clean code and a polished experience aren't in tension, they're the same goal. When I'm not pushing pixels, I'm usually mentoring, optimising something that didn't need optimising, or finding ways to bring AI tooling into the team's workflow.
